pages.comingSoon: This page is still being built.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.intro: Here you will see which parcels to send today and whom to call.

import.title: Import orders
import.intro: Upload one or more order files exported from Shopify (Orders → Export → CSV).

products.title: Products
products.intro: Here each product will have a photo, purchase price and weight.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: Here you will see how many pieces of each product are left.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Here you will find profit, shipping costs and import history.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: The owner changes the shop's settings here.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Sign in with the email and password the owner gave you.

errors.invalid: Wrong email or password. Check them and try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Sign-in failed. Try again in a moment.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: You signed in, but your account has not been added to the shop or has been disabled. Call the owner.

auth.accountSwitched: {{name}} signed in on this browser, so this window now works as {{name}} too. One browser = one person. For two people on one computer, use a separate browser (for example Edge) or an incognito window (Ctrl+Shift+N).

dev.title: Connection check
dev.intro: Open this page on two computers. A change on one should appear on the other within a few seconds.
dev.presenceTitle: Who is looking at the test shipment
dev.presenceIntro: Both computers should show the other person's name.
dev.presenceNobody: Nobody else is looking at this shipment

import.ownerOnly: Only the owner imports orders. If a new file needs importing, call the owner.

drop.title: Drop the CSV files here
drop.hint: or click to choose them. Several files at once are fine.

import.duplicate: This file was already imported on {{date}} (“{{name}}”). Nothing was changed.
import.failed: The import failed and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
import.failedOffline: No connection to the server. Nothing was saved. Check the internet and try again.
import.failedOwnerOnly: Only the owner can import orders.

batch.csvGone: The file was removed from the cloud. The copy is in the archive: {{where}}
batch.loadFailed: The orders could not be loaded. Try again.
batch.multiLegend: Yellow row = a customer with more than one order, or an order with more than one product.
batch.multiRow: More than one order or product
batch.columnsHint: Choose the columns in Settings → Columns.

settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner changes the settings.

columns.title: Columns in the view and in Excel
columns.intro: Choose which columns are shown and in which order. This changes only the view and the downloaded Excel — the data in the app stays the same.
columns.dragHint: Drag a row to move it, or use the arrows.

archive.title: CSV file archive
archive.intro: Files older than {{days}} days are saved to a folder on the owner's computer, checked, and only then removed from the cloud. Without a saved copy nothing is deleted.
archive.noFolder: No folder chosen on this computer yet.
archive.allowHint: The browser asks for permission again before it saves to the folder.
archive.denied: The browser did not allow saving to the folder. Choose the folder again.
archive.computerHint: Saved next to every archived file, so you know which computer has it.
archive.nowHint: Saves all CSV files to the folder right away, without waiting {{days}} days.
archive.nothingWaiting: No files are waiting for archive.
archive.retriedDelete: “{{name}}” was removed from the cloud (its copy was saved earlier).
archive.failed: “{{name}}”: {{reason}}. The file stays in the cloud.
archive.failedDelete: “{{name}}” was saved to the folder but not removed from the cloud — we will try again.

reason.download: could not be downloaded from the cloud
reason.checksum: the downloaded file differs from the imported one
reason.write: could not be saved to the folder
reason.verify: the saved copy differs from the imported file
reason.confirm: could not be recorded as archived
reason.delete: could not be removed from the cloud

archive.unsupported: This browser cannot save to a folder (that works in Chrome and Edge). Download the files as a ZIP and save it yourself.
archive.zipReady_one: A ZIP with {{count}} file was downloaded. Save it on the computer, then press “I have saved them”.
archive.zipReady_other: A ZIP with {{count}} files was downloaded. Save it on the computer, then press “I have saved them”.
archive.loadFailed: The archive could not be checked. Try again later.
archive.banner_one: {{count}} CSV file is waiting for archive
archive.banner_other: {{count}} CSV files are waiting for archive
